title: Calm luxury
one_liner: The camera never moves, only you do: one small white serif line, warm window light, hard cuts, no effects, and it loops.
best_for: Premium or slow-living brands, coaches and makers who want to look expensive and unhurried. Best with hands-at-work or product footage; works on a talking head if you film locked off by a window.
effort: Low: phone on a stand, one font, no animation. Most of the work is filming in good window light.

palette.use: every word on screen: white, no shadow, stroke or box
deep shadow / background ink (blacks stay deep, never faded)
warm walnut surface (wood, linen) under the subject
oat mid-tones: linen, ceramics, window-lit surfaces
soft window glow / off-white ceramic, highlights held below clipping

pace: Normal speaking speed (162-172 words a minute), never sped up. Talking holds of 8-15 s; detail shots of 0.6-1.9 s cut on the finished action. Calm comes from stillness, not slow cutting.
signature_moves: Locked-off camera: no zooms, punch-ins or shake. Only the subject moves.
One small white serif line (Newsreader, ~51 px) that swaps hard on each phrase. No animation, no highlight word.
Bookend loop: the last shot returns to the opening shot and the last line flows back into the first.
